Description: Every retainer with gil, items and venture timer.
Help: Updated when you open a summoning bell.
Empty: No retainers yet. Open a summoning bell once with each character.
UnavailableHint: Listed at the summoning bell but cannot be summoned (for example, the extra retainer service lapsed). Its last known items are kept.
NoItems: No items saved yet. Call this retainer once at a summoning bell.
